integrity: Exact subgroup parametrization, cover correspondence, and finite counting proof. The standalone exhaustive small-order checks are corroborative, not a proof in unbounded order. Originality is assessed against accessible sources only.
scientific_limitations: Applies to full actual subgroup chains of generalized dihedral groups with finite abelian kernel; not to conjugacy classes of chains or arbitrary solvable groups. The factorial-density upper bound is not asserted sharp. Historical priority requires further independent investigation.
title: A two-adic counting law for increasing maximal subgroup chains in generalized dihedral groups
